scope: Bounded evidence migration pilot for proposed RFC 464; no repository policy adoption.
measurement: Sum of Git blob sizes under evidence/minicpm-vllm-seedtts, including this report and core-integrity.json; not working-tree disk use or compressed Git storage. Modified files count their old blob as deleted and new blob as added.
preservation: All 56 original files were packed from Git blobs unchanged; archive uploaded, publicly downloaded and verified before removing original detail files. Metadata authority: results/artifacts.json.

coverage.scope: Every retained service cell, managed component execution, named diagnostic/proposal and excluded screen in the dec7a734 public result records. Per-request samples are not trials. No completeness claim for unarchived private runs or logs.

frozen_checker.limits: No GPU rerun, external audio/model verification or service qualification.

verification.limits: CPU checks only. No GPU, model, inaccessible audio, private-log or service qualification rerun. Remote availability is an observation, not a perpetual guarantee.

integration: Squash merge is required: the compact final tree avoids adding original large PR blobs to main ancestry. Earlier branch commits remain; no main history rewrite.
